Kotogen takes no pull requests, and this one will be closed without being
merged.

If it fixes a bug or carries an idea, describe what you saw in an
[issue](https://github.com/delordt/kotogen/issues) instead: what is taken up is
written in the repository from the description, and
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/delordt/kotogen/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md)
says why.
